definitions.gloss: all circles; various fields; all walks of life
definitions.explanation: Refers collectively to different sectors, industries, or spheres of society. Commonly used in formal contexts such as news reports and official statements.

examples.japanese: {各界|かっかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{各界|かっかい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: This policy is drawing attention from all sectors.

examples.japanese: {各界|かっかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{有識者|ゆうしきしゃ}→有識者：13022_yuushikisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招|まね}いて→招く：02425_maneku⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A meeting was held inviting experts from various fields.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word that appears frequently in news articles and official communications. Often followed by ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (from) or ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ to describe people or reactions from multiple sectors of society.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {各界|かっかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧ (representatives from various fields)
- {各界|かっかい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧ (to attract attention from all sectors)
- {各界|かっかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{著名人|ちょめいじん}→著名人：23055_chomeijin⟧ (prominent figures from various fields)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {各方面|かくほうめん}: various quarters, all sides — similar in meaning, slightly broader
- {各分野|かくぶんや}: each field, various disciplines — more specific to academic or professional areas
